title: Vertical walls.
officialText:
In sizing roof drains and storm drainage piping, one-half of the area of any vertical wall that diverts rainwater
to the roof shall be added to the projected roof area for inclusion in calculating the required size of vertical conductors, leaders and
horizontal storm drainage piping.
Exception: Where vertical conductors or leaders and downstream piping has been sized for secondary roof drainage in accordance
with Section 1107, the contribution from vertical walls need not be added to the projected roof area.
